# Frozen measured point/plane output

Author: Motion Studio contributors. License: MIT, as this repository.
These two files are independently authored validation assets, not product media
or third-party benchmark photographs. No Adobe assets or code are included.

The source was generated by `tools/tracking/validate_prototype.py` at revision
`6bfb541b9bb3cf2b3ada479f31cfc5dfb7f28183`, using NumPy 2.4.6,
opencv-python-headless 5.0.0.93 and the explicitly selected FFmpeg executable.
It is a seeded grayscale texture transformed over 96 frames at 24 fps, with
blank frames 20–24. `tracks.mstrack` is the actual CLI optical-flow output,
including missing observations and the explicit frame-30 manual corrections;
it is not analytic truth substituted for a measured solve. The copies are
byte-for-byte unchanged from the archived synthetic-v4 evaluation.
The local `.gitattributes` disables newline conversion for both identity-bound
files, including Windows checkouts with `core.autocrlf=true`.

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| motion.webm | 2790125 | `3d83869cf562e3708faac68567a85cb1c429c538286805139927c9b26b04fc06` |
| tracks.mstrack | 93399 | `bf02b43596c206cef0d9451e08a98409076ede774a8257a87141a260ad05cf55` |

To generate a fresh evaluation (use a new output directory):

```text
python tools/tracking/validate_prototype.py --ffmpeg /absolute/path/to/ffmpeg --ffprobe /absolute/path/to/ffprobe --output new-evaluation
```

Fresh measurements may differ by tool/platform. Do not silently regenerate
these frozen files or substitute new solve bytes just to pass a renderer test.
The original evaluation and native-import reports in `engineering/validation`
retain the analytic accuracy gate and tool identities. This fixture tests the
subsequent actual Surface, retained-front, missing-frame, history and persistence
boundaries without installing Python/CV packages in native test CI.

Run on Windows with the existing shared FFmpeg runtime configured:

```text
cargo test -p motion-desktop --features ffmpeg --bin motion-studio frozen_prototype_observations_present_retain_refuse_missing_and_recover -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture
```

This does not establish real photographed tracking quality, project-wide
rational frame rates, Android behavior or other platforms' Surface behavior.
